text_block_list.name: Verxina & Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
――HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
――DORYAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Verxina!
Just power through the home stretch and swim all the way――!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golshi-chan wins~!! Which means, what else?! To commemorate this fierce battle, lemme treat ya to some mustard yakisoba――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations.
However, I must decline. I already have plans.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's with that dry attitude? Get messy with it! Coat it thick like sauce, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Verxina...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's almost bath time, but...
I guess they're still not back yet, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I bet she's over there.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Whew…… Just a little more, perhaps……?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If you swim that much, your body's gonna get chilled, you know?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Tarumae-san……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...That showdown during the day was quite the fierce battle, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san's charge from behind was amazing, but Verxina-san was also――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But...
I just really need to keep swimming right now.
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Okay, got it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Here, I brought some snacks♪
Eat them during your break!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard! You've got this, Verxina-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Tarumae.
But I can't afford to lean on you right now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I came in second.
When it was I who should have claimed the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Even if everyone else forgives it... I never will.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter what formidable opponent stands in my way,
the only one worthy of the pinnacle is me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way home from work, I spotted an Umamusume.
Curfew is approaching... I should probably call out to her.
choice_data_list: Don't overdo it, even with proactive training!
It's dark out already, so head home soon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. But it's necessary in order to stand at the top.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I will spare no effort.
Next time, I will undoubtedly claim the pinnacle.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I shall head home early. My roommate
must be worried about me.
